inherited_checks.scope: Historical base qualification; dependency locks and base runtime remain unchanged, while browser capture and its packaging are qualified separately.

release_overlay: security reporting policy, requiring live private-reporting verification at publication
manual package/image attestation workflows with distinct asset names
consumer checksum and authenticated provenance instructions
opt-in browser capture, encrypted retry queue and account-bound admission
browser source packaging and container build-context inclusion
independent published package/image consumption on macOS and both Linux architectures

capture_qualification.real_account_scope: Two ChatGPT accounts, one Claude account and one Grok account: capture, exact evidence and duplicate-free replay/reconnect.
capture_qualification.limits: Opened foreground rendered text only. Capture time is not original message time; exports remain the completeness fallback.

identity: The current clean Git commit identifies this source; workflows bind artifacts to that revision.
historical_provenance: PILOT-SOURCE.json retains the inherited archive/overlay history, not the current installed revision.
limits: Inherited tests are not a friend-owned trial or universal answer-quality proof.
Release signing, public reporting and independent public install need actual publication results.
